apps.name: Laya
apps.subtitle: Music player with lyrics, karaoke and Listen Together.
apps.localizedDescription: Laya is a music player with synced lyrics, on-device karaoke, Listen Together, Atmos-style reverb and home-screen widgets.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Laya saves your Replay and lyrics cards to your photo library when you tap Save.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Laya finds Chromecasts and Google Cast speakers on your Wi-Fi so you can play music on them.
